response: Kandivali (ward R/S) billed Rs 6642234 for monsoon road repairs against a budget of Rs 6600000, or 100.6 percent of budget, across 121 jobs. Of these, 20.7 percent were reopened within 30 days and 56.2 percent met their deadline. The city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season, which may explain some repeat damage. Rs 543742 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs there should cost the city nothing. These bills need review. Also, 8 jobs were priced more than 30 percent above the rate card and should be checked. The top contractor by spend is Western Coast Asphalt Co (synthetic). Example work orders include WO25-00018 and WO25-00197. A citizen or ward officer can ask the ward office whether WO25-00018 was on a DLP road, and if so, why the city paid for it.
